Labs & games

Learn by exploring.

Some ideas are easier to understand by touching them: the human body in 3D, the history of life, the world’s faiths, Norway’s economy and the models behind spacecraft and buildings. Some things are better played, so the games and worlds run in your browser too.

Science & the body 5

  • Anatomy · 3D13.2 MBCorpusInteractive 3D anatomy atlasBuild and dissect the human body in 3D. Fill the gaps with the male model's skull, ribs, muscles, vessels and nerves, then peel layers, pull muscles apart or cut the body from the top or front. English and Arabic.Open lab →
  • Anatomy · ClinicalHeart & BrainClinical 3D atlasTap any chamber, vessel or brain region to see its anatomy and clinical relevance. Watch a beating heart, follow the blood flow, switch lobes and functional areas, and slice through with a section plane.Open lab →
  • Anatomy · JourneyInner VoyageA journey through the human bodyFive stops through the body, from a beating heart to a strand of DNA. Drag to turn the body, then tap a glowing label.Open lab →
  • Evolution · TimelineLIFEThe journey of evolutionAn interactive 3D timeline of the history of life. Each claim shows how strongly the evidence supports it and how its dates were measured. English, Arabic and Norwegian.Open lab →
  • Health · ClinicalCareOS TwinClinical workspace, replayExplore a synthetic patient record: results, care pathway, tasks, notes and an audit trail. This is a recorded replay, so nothing needs to be connected.Open lab →

Faith, history & economy 3

  • History · FaithsHumanityThe journey of beliefFly through human history, compare beliefs side by side, visit sacred places in 3D, and ask the historian questions answered from the sources.Open lab →
  • Faith · Fact checkMiracles in the QuranTesting a viral claim against the numbersChecks the claim that verse numbers encode Earth's core depth. Shows what holds up, what does not, and how other well-known 'miracles' are read.Open lab →
  • Economy · SimulationNorway Economy SimulatorOfficial statistics, simulated to 2035Every krone, person and industry, from official statistics since 2000 to a simulated 2035. Spin the 3D model, scrub through time and change the levers. Figures from Statistics Norway and Norges Bank.Open lab →

Space & 3D architecture 5

  • Space · Engineering5.8 MBNORGE EVA · Build LabBuild a 3D astronaut suitExplore a 3D astronaut suit, drive it with keyboard or gamepad, follow the build steps, and view its blueprint and cost.Open lab →
  • Space · Digital twin10.3 MBASTRA TWINAstronaut, suit and mission as one systemRotate a 3D astronaut model, switch between body, suit and mission views, run scenarios and replay a timeline.Open lab →
  • Space · PlanningLunar Site NavigatorPick a site near the lunar south polePick dates and candidate sites near the lunar south pole, then compare sunlight and Earth-in-view windows. Synthetic data.Open lab →
  • Architecture · 3DCommercial Building, City CentreA 3D building from DWG drawingsOrbit and zoom a 3D commercial building, cut it at any floor and spread the floors apart. Toggle glass, plans and labels.Open lab →
  • Architecture · 3DWalkway Commercial Block 39A 3D four-level commercial blockOrbit a 3D four-level commercial block, cut it at any floor, and toggle glass, plans and labels.Open lab →

Games & worlds 5

  • Game · ArcadeNight Circuit ArcadeThree games in one neon arcadeNeon Drift, a synthwave racer with blasters and missions; Void Dominion, a real-time strategy battle against a commander; and Endless Saga, a dungeon-crawling RPG. Best played on a phone in portrait.Open lab →
  • Game · Language learningNorsk QuestLearn Norwegian by playingLearn Norwegian from zero to C2 with a gamified path, job tracks, mini-games and grammar, at your own pace.Open lab →
  • Game · RoboticsRobot WorkshopBuild a working robot, one part at a timeVolt, your guide, explains what each part does. Build the robot, program it and test it in the arena across three missions. Works with mouse, touch or a VR headset.Open lab →
  • Game · StrategyCrucible FrontiersA real-time strategy gamePick a faction and a mode, then fight in real time. Includes a tutorial, survival and a battle lab.Open lab →
  • Game · 3D world2.9 MBGorgov Valley of CreationA WebGL night-desert worldScroll through a night-desert world built around Gorgov Digital's pyramid logo. Seven scarabs are hidden in it.Open lab →

Tools & dashboards 2

  • Tool · AI agentsHarness BuilderDesign AI agent harnessesBuild and compare AI agent harness diagrams by dragging nodes, with templates and an architect flow.Open lab →
  • Tool · SecurityHeimdall Network WatchNetwork security dashboardA threat radar, map, risk matrix and filters for network security, shown on demo data.Open lab →

Labs run in your browser. Those with 3D graphics need WebGL, which most phones and computers support. Sizes are shown for labs over 2 MB.
